{"claims":[{"claim_text":"The Administration has greatly increased civil and criminal enforcement of the nation's environmental laws.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Increased funding for the Justice Department and Environmental Protection Agency has resulted in faster cleanups and tougher compliance.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Support for increased monitoring, transparency, and community engagement in environmental work.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The clean energy boom is breaking the industry's monopoly hold on energy markets.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"For the first time in 100 years, oil and gas companies are paying increased royalties to drill or mine on public lands.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The bonds required for companies to be held accountable for cleaning up drilling sites or capping abandoned wells are now at least 10 times more expensive.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"States and private landowners have for years charged more than the federal government to lease their lands.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Taxpayers should receive a similar return from federal land leases as states and private landowners receive.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Tens of billions of dollars in unfair oil and gas subsidies will be eliminated.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"When windfall profiteering causes prices to spike at the pump, supplies will be released to keep costs down for American families.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Oil and gas executives will be held accountable for potential collusion or price-gouging.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
